name.ja: BB戦士 355徳川家康頑駄無(トクガワイエヤスガンダム)

description.ja: • 天下を握った「戦略家武将！徳川家康！」ここに降臨す！ • メタリックランナーとパールランナーを効果的に採用し「征夷大将軍、徳川家康」の鎧兜を演出！ • 3つのモード（軽装モード、武将モード、サポートメカ白石と合体し、超武装モードへ）へ変形。 • 西軍（豊臣勢）に対する東軍（徳川勢）には「足軽兵暴留」が付属。 • 自陣の目印の「幟」が付属。 • 野戦が得意な家康ならではの豊富な武装（「童子切安綱」＆「討魔弓」「龍馬頭ファング」「大目牙ハイパーバズーカ」）。 成型品×8、ホイルシール×1、組立説明書×1
description.en: • The "Strategist Warlord! Tokugawa Ieyasu!" who ruled the world is here! • Metallic Runner and Pearl Runner are effectively used to create the armor of " Shogun Tokugawa Ieyasu "! • Transforms into three modes (light armor mode, military commander mode, and combines with support mecha Shiraishi to become super armed mode). • The eastern army (Tokugawa army) against the western army (Toyotomi army) comes with " Ashigaru Hei Burutu ". • Comes with a " nobori " to mark your own camp. • A wealth of armaments unique to Ieyasu, who is good at field battles (" Dojigiri Yasutsuna " & " Touma Bow ", " Ryomazu Fang ", " Daime Fang Hyper Bazooka"). Molded product x 8, foil seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
